# Excalidraw Fractional Indexing

This layer contains the source code for fractional indexing, including utilities for generating and validating keys.

## Responsibilities

- Provides utilities for generating and validating keys.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`packages/fractional-indexing/src/index.ts`](../../packages/fractional-indexing/src/index.ts) | Exports key generation and validation functions. | `BASE_62_DIGITS`, `validateOrderKey`, `generateKeyBetween`, `generateNKeysBetween`, `midpoint`, `validateInteger` |

## How it works

The `index.ts` file exports key generation and validation functions. The key generation functions include `generateKeyBetween`, `generateNKeysBetween`, and `midpoint`, while the validation functions include `validateOrderKey` and `validateInteger`.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `packages/fractional-indexing/tsconfig.json`.
